import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { LayoutStatus } from './Types.js';

const zh = {
	navigation: '应用导航',
	minimalEdition: '专注当前 · 01',
	minimalTitle: '日常工作，有序展开。',
	minimalDescription: '将常用面板放在手边，为专注留出空间。',
	minimalFooter: 'ASAM · 浏览器工作台 / 布局仅保存在当前身份范围',
	brandEdition: '工作空间 / 02',
	brandTitle: '把工作，放回你的节奏。',
	brandDescription: '从左侧启程，在同一张桌面保持上下文。',
	brandHeader: '我的桌面',
	brandSubtitle: '窗口、面板与偏好',
	brandFooter: 'ASAM · 让每一个工作面板各就其位',
	techTitle: '工作台 / 在线',
	techDescription: '将信息面板编排为可恢复的工作现场。',
	techFooter: 'ASAM / 浏览器会话 · 权限由宿主实时提供',
	launcher: '快捷入口',
	noPanels: '当前没有可用面板',
	layoutPreferences: '布局偏好',
	saveLayout: '保存布局',
	restoreLayout: '恢复布局',
	resetLayout: '重置布局',
	workspace: '窗口工作区',
	idleTitle: '为当前工作留出空间',
	idleDescription: '从快捷入口打开面板，或从任务栏恢复。',
	minimize: (title: string) => `最小化 ${title}`,
	maximize: (title: string) => `最大化 ${title}`,
	restoreWindow: (title: string) => `还原 ${title}`,
	close: (title: string) => `关闭 ${title}`,
	move: (title: string) => `移动 ${title}`,
	resize: (title: string) => `调整大小 ${title}`,
	panelPlaceholder: (title: string) => `由宿主注入 ${title} 内容。`,
	taskbar: '任务栏',
	switchPanels: '切换面板',
	openPanels: '已打开',
	minimized: ' · 已最小化',
	noWindows: '暂无窗口',
	storage: {
		missing: '使用默认布局',
		ok: '布局已就绪',
		migrated: '布局已迁移',
		invalid: '布局损坏，可重置',
		future: '布局版本较新，可重置',
		expired: '布局已过期，使用默认布局',
		unavailable: '存储不可用，当前会话可继续',
		disposed: '工作台已销毁',
		stale: '旧操作已忽略',
		conflict: '另一工作台已修改布局，请恢复或重置'
	} satisfies Record<LayoutStatus, string>
};

const en: typeof zh = {
	navigation: 'Application navigation',
	minimalEdition: 'Focus on today · 01',
	minimalTitle: 'Make room for your daily work',
	minimalDescription: 'Keep your everyday panels close and give yourself room to focus.',
	minimalFooter: 'ASAM · Browser desktop / Layout saved for the current identity only',
	brandEdition: 'Workspace / 02',
	brandTitle: 'Work at your own pace',
	brandDescription: 'Start from the sidebar and keep your work together on one desktop.',
	brandHeader: 'My desktop',
	brandSubtitle: 'Windows, panels, and preferences',
	brandFooter: 'ASAM · A place for each of your work panels',
	techTitle: 'Workspace / Online',
	techDescription: 'Arrange your panels in a workspace you can restore.',
	techFooter: 'ASAM / Browser session · The host manages permissions in real time',
	launcher: 'Panel shortcuts',
	noPanels: 'No panels are available',
	layoutPreferences: 'Layout preferences',
	saveLayout: 'Save layout',
	restoreLayout: 'Restore layout',
	resetLayout: 'Reset layout',
	workspace: 'Window workspace',
	idleTitle: 'Make room for your work',
	idleDescription: 'Open a panel from the shortcuts or restore one from the taskbar.',
	minimize: (title) => `Minimize ${title}`,
	maximize: (title) => `Maximize ${title}`,
	restoreWindow: (title) => `Restore ${title}`,
	close: (title) => `Close ${title}`,
	move: (title) => `Move ${title}`,
	resize: (title) => `Resize ${title}`,
	panelPlaceholder: (title) => `The host supplies the content for ${title}.`,
	taskbar: 'Taskbar',
	switchPanels: 'Switch panels',
	openPanels: 'Open panels',
	minimized: ' · Minimized',
	noWindows: 'No open windows',
	storage: {
		missing: 'Using the default layout',
		ok: 'Layout is ready',
		migrated: 'Layout migrated',
		invalid: 'Layout is invalid. You can reset it.',
		future: 'The layout uses a newer version. You can reset it.',
		expired: 'The layout expired. Using the default layout.',
		unavailable: 'Storage is unavailable. You can continue in this session.',
		disposed: 'The desktop has been closed',
		stale: 'The previous operation was skipped',
		conflict: 'Another desktop changed the layout. Restore or reset it.'
	}
};

export function useDesktopLocale() {
	const { locale } = useAsamI18n();
	return computed(() => (locale.value === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh-CN'));
}

export function useDesktopCopy() {
	const locale = useDesktopLocale();
	return computed(() => (locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh));
}
